args.subject: Welcome to the Team, David!
args.body:
Hi David,

I hope this email finds you well! My name is Emma Johnson, and I'm a colleague at Blue Sparrow Tech.

I heard from Alice that you'll be joining our team next week, and I wanted to be one of the first to welcome you aboard. We're all excited to have you here, and I'm sure you'll fit right in.

If you have any questions before your first day or need help settling in, please don't hesitate to reach out. I'd be happy to help.

Looking forward to meeting you in person soon!

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
